summary.overview: In the one-on-one performance review and strategy discussion meeting between David and Andrew, they addressed key issues regarding management responsibilities and deal strategies. The conversation began with an exploration of the recent acquisition of Daniel and Joe to serve Smith Media clients, revealing concerns about unclear management roles and process oversight. David elaborated on his project management style while Andrew expressed frustration over slow deal progress, particularly regarding the Shopper Group and Zen Media accounts. They agreed on the necessity of designating clear leads for each deal and restructuring to enhance communication and visibility. David expressed his desire for greater involvement in the early stages of deals, which led to a consensus on reallocating responsibilities, particularly in M&A processes. Action items were assigned, including David taking direct control of specific deals and Andrew improving data sharing, while Jack was tasked with expediting the Zen Media deal. The meeting concluded with a plan to shift M&A calls to Mondays for better management oversight.
summary.short_summary: During a one-on-one performance review, David and Andrew addressed management responsibilities and deal strategies, focusing on the recent acquisition of Daniel and Joe for Smith Media clients. They expressed concerns regarding unclear management roles and process oversight, particularly in the slow progress of deals related to Shopper Group and Zen Media accounts. David shared insights about his project management style, while Andrew voiced his frustrations. They agreed on the importance of designating clear leads for each deal and enhancing communication and visibility within their processes. Furthermore, David sought a more active role in the early stages of deals, leading to a consensus on reallocating responsibilities, especially in M&A. Action items included David taking direct control of specific deals, Andrew improving data sharing, and Jack being tasked with expediting the Zen Media deal. The meeting concluded with a plan to shift M&A calls to Mondays for better oversight.
